title: Brand New Tube: 349.6K accounts breached
summary: In August 2022, the streaming website Brand New Tube suffered a data breach that exposed the personal information of almost 350k subscribers. The impacted data included email and IP addresses, usernames, genders,  passwords stored as unsalted SHA-1 hashes and private messages.
